findings.description: The pipeline incorrectly populates the prorated indicator column as True for every participant who has a valid total score, regardless of whether any questions were actually skipped or answered completely.
findings.evidence: 100% of rows with a non-null total score have _prorated = True across PHQ-9, GAD-7, and RSES, even for participants with 0 missing responses (e.g., 399 respondents with 0 missing PHQ-9 items have phq9_prorated = True).
